report.question: Which public function, CLI, and config defaults have zero exercising callers because callers pass them explicitly, and which shipped-CI default leaves a branch unexercised?
report.answer: On this worktree the shipped Python surface under tools,platform has 194 public/default parameters and 108 CLI flag defaults. 70 function defaults are explicit-only, 65 are unreferenced, 58 are exercised by product or asserting tests. validate.require_complete (keyword-only, default False at validate.py:85) is exercised by asserting tests that omit it, so it is NOT reported. CLI --require-complete (store_true at validate.py:340) is reported unexercised in shipped CI: frozen quality.yml invokes validate.py bare and never passes the flag. Duplicate SkillFile classes are absent on this tree; the detector self-test plants two and requires the three render defaults to stay explicit-only. Absent catalog roots: .agents/skills,skills,scripts,ci.
tests_required_verbatim: Control: the known require_complete default must be reported unexercised while CI invokes the tool bare.
Control: a default exercised by at least one asserting test must NOT be reported.
Control: a default whose value is read from the environment must be classified separately (environment-dependent default), not as exercised.
report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: Each finding names the default, its declaration site, and the count of call sites that pass it explicitly. A default exercised only by a test that also asserts nothing is reported as unexercised.
